caveats: No public offering at all as of 2026-09-29: fluidstack.io is now a mission/recruiting site (no product, pricing, sign-up or contact-sales link); /pricing and /gpu-cloud return 404 (Wayback: /pricing 404 since at least 2026-01-28). The platform (docs.fluidstack.io: managed Kubernetes/Slurm, alpha instances API) serves existing contracted customers via a Technical Account Manager. Last published list prices (Wayback 2025-10-17, historic, not current): H100 SXM $2.10, H200 SXM $2.30, A100 80GB $1.30 per GPU-hour; B200/GB200 'On Request'.
Any null count, CPU/RAM, billing increment or minimum is unverified, not unlimited/free.
This is GPU-product research, not a claim that every feature of the entire vendor documentation was audited. Unverified features are null.
GPU multi-count bundles, variant/region selection and fractional slices require a SKU-aware estimator; unsupported rows remain unpriced in strict cards.

Modes with gpu=null are intentionally excluded, not free GPU modes. Never substitute 0 for a null rate. Flags alt indicate DIY/ML infrastructure, not the same thing as managed untrusted-code sandboxes.
Unknown fee, storage or bandwidth means full monthly total may be unavailable. Rates exclude taxes.

Instances API (v1alpha1, regional https://<region>.atlas.fluidstack.io) supports preemptible and ephemeral instances, CPU instance types (CLI default 'cpu.2x') and GPU types like 'h100.8x', plus start/stop. Prices, billing increment and preemptible discount are not published; access is contract-only.

Contract terms (T&Cs): fees set per Order, 'payable in advance', 'non-cancellable, non-refundable' unless the Order says otherwise; per-minute/per-hour fees may require an advance deposit and access 'may cease' if funds run out (hard stop); subscriptions auto-renew; renewal price increases of at least 3%/year allowed with 30 days notice.
